data.name: The Wolf in Me
data.detailed_description:
EMBRACE THE BEAST

The Wolf in Me is a narrative-driven action game about losing control… and choosing whether to take it back.

You play as Harley, born of human and werewolf blood, carrying a prophecy that could destroy an entire race. In a world where humanity survives in the shadow of the beast, control is the only thing standing between you and what you could become.

Combat is built around a simple idea:
The more you fight, the harder it is to stop.

Fight aggressively and unleash devastating power, but risk losing control.
Hold back and stay human, but face a harsher path.

Every action has consequences.
Your choices shape how the world reacts, how people see you, and what you ultimately become.

You are not just fighting enemies.
You are fighting yourself.

FEATURES

Lose control in combat
The more aggressive you play, the closer you get to becoming an unstoppable force.

Humanity vs bestiality system
Your actions shape your character, the world, and the story.

Brutal, reactive combat
Heavy impacts, enemy reactions, finishers, and dismemberment.

Transform into the beast
Gain overwhelming power at the cost of control.

A dark folklore world
Explore a world where humanity survives under the rule of werewolves.

A story shaped by your actions
Your choices influence relationships, outcomes, and the tone of the journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, Intel Core i7-4770K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (Version 1909 or Newer)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
